en: A vintage postcard showing a market square with a war memorial statue in the center, surrounded by a decorative fence. The background consists of traditional European buildings with gabled roofs, shops, and signs. A street lamp is visible on the right, and several people are standing in front of the monument. The postcard is captioned in German: 'Penig. Markt mit Kriegerdenkmal.'
